Matte flat sage-green tops, mint light planes, emerald/dark-teal short front faces. Two or three large SOLID color planes per material. No gradients, texture, tiny grass dots, noise, airbrush, shadows cast on background, 3D, or pixel art.

TOP LEFT: one large absolutely uniform flat sage-green canopy color rectangle with NO outlines/no details/no flowers, meant to be sampled as a solid interior fill.
TOP RIGHT: an isolated short low angular grass clump, with pointed broad triangle leaves and navy outline, roughly twice as wide as tall, no roots or dirt.
MIDDLE LEFT: one long HORIZONTAL NORTH-edge grass rim ribbon, about 800px long by90px deep. Its inner lower half is plain flat sage-green. Its exposed top silhouette is low, sharp, stepped tufts and wedges edged in navy. Open cut ends with NO vertical cap lines.

Along bottom is a short dark-teal vertical raised front face and thick navy bottom edge, with occasional low pointy grass lobes. Open cut ends, NO vertical cap lines.

BOTTOM RIGHT: one long VERTICAL EAST edge rim ribbon, about90pxwide by650px tall: plain sage on inner LEFT, thin dark-teal face/navy exposed RIGHT, low angular pointed leaf breaks, open ends.
